column3: The Hebrew makes seeing His power and glory the purpose of seeing Him in the sanctuary; BSB coordinates seen and beheld.
The Hebrew explicitly names fat and rich fatness; BSB says the richest of foods.
The Hebrew says You have been help to me; BSB says You are my help.
The Hebrew expresses clinging and supporting as completed actions; BSB uses present verbs.
The Hebrew describes people pouring him out over the hands of a sword; BSB says they will fall to the sword’s power.
The Hebrew has a singular mouth of those speaking falsehood; BSB has mouths.
